title: Keto Cannellini Bean Stew
description: A hearty and comforting keto stew made with cannellini beans, aromatic spices, and Syrian-inspired flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the minced garlic and chopped onion, cooking until the onion is translucent.
Add the stew ingredients (beef broth, diced tomatoes, and aromatic spices) and stir to combine.
Add the cannellini beans and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Note: This recipe is keto-friendly, but be mindful of the serving size and ingredients to ensure it fits within your daily keto macros.
